end.summary:
Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya identified a spaceship as a toy and described a cylinder as long and round.
They described a cube as having six square faces and a cylinder as having two flat faces.
They identified cone and sphere using pointy and ball-like features.
Teach-back was not passed; 2 of 5 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes through toy and object examples, focusing on faces, flat surfaces and curved surfaces. Aditya explained cube, cylinder, cone and sphere features, including why objects may roll. The cylinder examples were mixed up at first, and the two flat faces were later stated correctly. At home, ask Aditya to find one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere and describe one feature of each.
